vectors.description: minimal FETCH with no parameters. A FETCH with no LOCATION_FILTER is unfiltered (Section 9.19.9) and is answered by REQUEST_OK (Section 9.3)
FETCH with multi-element namespace

FETCH with a type 0x01 (Relative Start) LOCATION_FILTER, StartGroup=0. Section 3.2: "If the Location filter is relative (see Section 9.19.9), the publisher MUST return REQUEST_ERROR with error code INVALID_RANGE." The frame decodes; the refusal is a request error, not a session close

FETCH with a type 0x01 (Relative Start) LOCATION_FILTER, StartGroup=3. Section 3.2: "If the Location filter is relative (see Section 9.19.9), the publisher MUST return REQUEST_ERROR with error code INVALID_RANGE." The frame decodes; the refusal is a request error, not a session close
FETCH with a type 0x05 LOCATION_FILTER, the Next Object. Section 9.19.9: "If Location Filter Type is 0x05, no fields follow and it specifies the Next Object." The vector asserts the decode only
FETCH with a type 0x02 (Absolute Start) LOCATION_FILTER: absolute start {10,3}. Section 9.19.9: "When they are omitted from a Fetch, the EndGroup and EndObject are Largest Object."
FETCH with a type 0x03 (Absolute Start, Group End) LOCATION_FILTER: start {10,3}, EndGroupDelta 5 so the End Group is 15, EndObject omitted so all objects in group 15 are included
FETCH with a type 0x04 (Absolute Range) LOCATION_FILTER: the inclusive range {10,3} through {15,7}
non-canonical FETCH — a type 0x02 LOCATION_FILTER whose StartGroup (10) is encoded as a 2-byte varint (800a) and StartObject (3) as one byte. Decode-only
FETCH with SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY parameter (16). Section 9.19.7: "If omitted from SUBSCRIBE or FETCH, the publisher uses the value 128."
FETCH with GROUP_ORDER parameter (descending=2). Section 9.19.8: "If omitted from FETCH, the receiver uses Ascending (0x1)."
FETCH with FILL_TIMEOUT parameter (5000ms)
FETCH with FILL_TIMEOUT=0
FETCH with INCLUDE_PROPERTIES (0x35) set to 0 — the FETCH_OK should carry an empty Track Properties field
FETCH with AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN parameter (USE_VALUE type=0, value='fetch-token')
FETCH with OBJECTID_FILTER (0x26): SetID 0, Object ID range 2-5
FETCH with PRIORITY_FILTER (0x27): SetID 0, Publisher Priority range 0-63
FETCH with SUBSCRIBER_PRIORITY (16), a type 0x04 LOCATION_FILTER covering {4,0} through {6,9} inclusive, and GROUP_ORDER (ascending=1); demonstrates type-delta ordering across 0x20, 0x21 and 0x22

FETCH whose LOCATION_FILTER carries Location Filter Type 0x40. Section 9.19.9: "If an endpoint receives any other Location Filter Type, it MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER." The type says how many fields follow, so a decoder cannot step over one it does not know
vectors.error_detail: Location Filter Type 0x40 is not defined; draft-23 defines 0x00 through 0x05

vectors.description: FETCH whose LOCATION_FILTER is type 0x04 but whose message ends after StartGroup and StartObject. The Message Length covers every byte, so the frame is complete and the parameter is not. Section 12.2: "MALFORMED_MESSAGE (0x300): A control message cannot be parsed or is missing a required element"
vectors.error_detail: a type 0x04 LOCATION_FILTER carries four fields and the message payload ends after two

vectors.description: FETCH whose type 0x03 LOCATION_FILTER has StartGroup = 2^64 - 1 and EndGroupDelta = 1. Section 9.19.9: "If StartGroup + EndGroupDelta exceeds 2^64 - 1, the endpoint MUST close the session with DELTA_ENCODING_OVERFLOW."
FETCH whose type 0x04 LOCATION_FILTER has StartGroup = 2^64 - 1, EndGroupDelta = 1 and EndObject = 0. The DELTA_ENCODING_OVERFLOW rule of Section 9.19.9 covers both types that carry an EndGroupDelta

FETCH carrying an empty FILL_PARAMETERS (0x23 00). Section 9.19.15 names SUBSCRIBE, SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, PUBLISH and REQUEST_UPDATE (for a subscription) only. Section 9.19.1: "If a parameter appears in some other type of message, the receiving endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
vectors.error_detail: FILL_PARAMETERS may appear only in SUBSCRIBE, SUBSCRIBE_TRACKS, PUBLISH or REQUEST_UPDATE for a subscription

vectors.description: FETCH carrying PAUSED (0x11) = 1. Section 9.19.18 does not name FETCH. Section 9.19.1: "If a parameter appears in some other type of message, the receiving endpoint MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."
vectors.error_detail: PAUSED is not listed for FETCH

vectors.description: FETCH with INCLUDE_PROPERTIES (0x35) carrying the value 255. Section 9.19.22: "If an endpoint receives a value outside this range, it MUST close the session with INVALID_PARAMETER."

FETCH (Request ID 2, namespace ('live')) with a zero-length Track Name and no parameters. Section 2.4.1: "If an endpoint receives a Track Name with a length of 0, it MUST close the session with a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION."
truncated FETCH — missing track_namespace
vectors.error_detail: unexpected end of input while reading track_namespace
